follow-up time: 60 days for CD, 2 months for TJA
exposure: Lower limb total major joint arthroplasty (TJA)
cohort: 55 patients recovering from lower limb total major joint arthroplasty (TJA) and 157 patients recovering from cesarean delivery (CD).
finding: Pain resolution after surgery follows a typical pattern with a transition to a different pattern of change in pain between days 10 and 21 after surgery.
mod_finding: Pain resolution after cesarean delivery follows a typical pattern with a transition to a different pattern of change in pain between days 10 and 21 after surgery.
